messages:
Maya (CEO): @here Quick invite  short all-hands this Tue 10:00am PT (40m). Please skim agenda and drop any quick Qs here or in the form. :calendar:
Maya (CEO): Agenda (concise):
- 6m: Exec pulse + hiring snapshot
- 12m: Product demo: feature rollout + canary gating (live)
- 7m: Policy update: audit & retention changes (what to expect)
- 10m: Roadmap highlights + Q&A (we'll prioritize pre-submitted)
- 5m: Close + owners
Maya (CEO): Slides & preread: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/redwood-tue-innovation (view/comment)
Priya (CPO): We'll demo the new latency-aware routing and show Hosted -> Dedicated fallback. Adding sample prompts to the deck so folks can reproduce locally.
Jamal (VP Product): Also showing the rollout feature flag and metric gates. Canary will run for 2h in staging before prod.
Kendall (Head Eng): Infra note: warmup window 15m before demo; SRE standby for 2h after rollout. I'll add the warmup script to the runbook.
Legal-bot: Policy preview: default internal dev org retention will change to 45 days. Enterprise customers retain per contract; exports preserved. Full policy doc will be published post-call.
Ivy (People Ops): In-person viewing + lunch signup here: tinyurl.com/rw-allhands-tue  RSVP by Mon 5pm.
Ops-bot: Calendar invite created company-wide. Recording + auto-captions enabled. Reminder at 30m.
Maya (CEO): If you can't attend live but want a prioritized question answered, add it to the Q&A form (1-2 bullets): https://forms.gle/redwood-tue-qa
Jamal (VP Product): Runbook draft (WIP): https://docs.google.com/document/d/redwood-rollout-tue  comments welcome.
Priya (CPO): Quick ask  if your team relies on >45d internal logs, file an exception request before Friday so we can evaluate retention needs.

-- meeting concluded --

Ops-bot: Recording uploaded: https://meet.google.com/rec-redwood-4312345678 (auto-transcript available)
Maya (CEO): Thanks all who joined live. High-level takeaways:
- Rollout green-lit for next Wed after canary
- Internal default retention reduced to 45 days; export options and enterprise retention unchanged
- Launch runbook and smoke tests look good; infra tuning items noted
Maya (CEO): Action items (owners & due dates):
- Jamal: finalize rollout checklist + metric gates (Due: Tue COB)
- Kendall: post warmup script and create burst-tuning tickets (Due: Mon EOD)
- Priya: coordinate customer comms draft with Sales & Support (Due: Wed EOD)
- Ivy: post recording + TL;DR to wiki and weekly digest (Due: Mon)
Legal-bot: Official policy doc will be published to the policy site and shared via email tomorrow.
Jamal (VP Product): Runbook link posted above  will iterate with comments.
Kendall (Head Eng): Tickets created and tagged @sre-oncall; will update #eng-runtime with progress.
Ivy (People Ops): Reply "anon" here if you want your question anonymized in the digest. We'll close this thread in 72h with a final action summary. :sparkles:
